description: State Representative Ryan Rose is Pro Faith, Pro Family & Pro Freedom - Rep. Rose has a 100% Pro-Life voting record and he is endorsed by Right to Life, the NRA and dozens of local & state leaders. Ryan relentlessly fights to uphold our shared traditional Arkansas Family Values and won't quit until the battle is won! Ryan is a husband, father, pastor, small business owner, pregnancy center president and graduate of the University of the Ozarks and Global University's BSB program.
